# Wordnik

> A comprehensive nonprofit dictionary platform and API providing word definitions, etymology, and community-driven language reference powered by multiple authoritative sources.

Wordnik combines crowdsourced word adoption with professional dictionary content from sources like The Century Dictionary, American Heritage Dictionary, and Wiktionary. The platform serves both casual word enthusiasts and developers through its public API and web interface.

## Key Topics

## Word Reference & Definitions

- [Word of the Day](https://wordnik.com/word-of-the-day): Daily word feature with definitions, etymology, and usage examples
- [company - definition and meaning](https://wordnik.com/words/company): Word definition page for 'company' with multiple dictionary sources
- [news - definition and meaning](https://wordnik.com/words/news): Word definition page for 'news' with multiple dictionary sources
- [code - definition and meaning](https://wordnik.com/words/code): Word definition page for 'code' with multiple dictionary sources
- [et cetera - definition and meaning](https://wordnik.com/words/et%20cetera): Word definition page for 'et cetera' with etymology and synonyms

## Community & Engagement

- [Adopt a Word at Wordnik!](https://wordnik.com/adoptaword): Word adoption fundraising program supporting Wordnik's nonprofit mission
- [Wordnik: Adopted Words](https://wordnik.com/adoptedwords): Showcase of community-adopted words and sponsors
- [Wordnik Community](https://wordnik.com/community): Community hub featuring user comments, word discussions, and social features
